trends.name: US-Iran Military Escalation
trends.summary: White House signals capability to seize Iran's Kharg Island while Trump rejects Putin's quid pro quo on Ukraine-Iran intelligence sharing. Escalating geopolitical tensions driving oil prices up 5 consecutive weeks and creating structural market volatility across energy, rates, and risk assets.

trends.name: 10Y Treasury Yield Approaching 4.50%
trends.summary: 10Y note yield up 45 basis points in 3 weeks, now 10bps away from 4.50% threshold that Trump administration resisted in April 2025. Erratic mortgage market volatility and structural rate regime shift creating headwinds for housing and refinancing activity.

trends.name: Super Micro Co-founder Indictment
trends.summary: Super Micro Computer co-founder indicted on Nvidia chip smuggling charges to China; stock plunges 33%. Raises critical questions about supply chain security, AI infrastructure integrity, and China export control enforcement with major implications for semiconductor sector.

trends.name: Russell 2000 Enters Correction Territory
trends.summary: Small-cap Russell 2000 becomes first major US benchmark to enter correction (>10% decline), signaling rotation away from growth. Combined with California housing crash fears below Great Recession levels, suggests broader economic softening and recession risk (36% per Kalshi betting markets).

trends.name: Gold Plunges 10% in Worst Weekly Rout
trends.summary: Gold drops nearly 10% in worst weekly performance since 2011, signaling breakdown of traditional safe-haven dynamics. Part of broader pattern where safe-haven assets are failing amid geopolitical stress, pushing investors to reassess portfolio hedging strategies.

trends.name: US Banking Deregulation & Capital Deployment
trends.summary: Banks prepare to deploy billions in freed-up capital after regulatory victory, signaling potential credit expansion and M&A acceleration. Ecolab on strategic M&A streak and multiple deal discussions indicate corporate sector gearing for consolidation wave.

trends.name: Mortgage Affordability Crisis Deepening
trends.summary: $400K mortgage payments doubled from $1,500 to $3,000/month since 2021; mortgage market back to erratic volatility after months of stability. Rising rates combined with inventory constraints creating structural headwinds for housing demand and consumer discretionary spending.

trends.name: Memory Chip Shortage & Semiconductor Supply
trends.summary: World's top semiconductor producers reporting memory chip crisis developments; Super Micro indictment adds supply chain security concerns. Critical input for AI infrastructure amid demand boom; supply constraints creating pricing power for remaining suppliers.

trends.name: Recession Probability Spiking
trends.summary: Kalshi betting markets pricing 36% US recession probability in next year at fresh YTD highs. Driven by rate spike, small-cap weakness, housing crash fears, and energy sector turbulence; pushes investors toward defensive positioning and income-focused strategies.

trends.name: Energy Sector Bifurcation & Risk
trends.summary: Oil prices climb 5th straight week on Iran military escalation, but Energy Transfer faces 4 critical hidden risks. Enterprise Products and dividend-focused energy ETFs attract income investors, but geopolitical volatility and structural energy transition create sector-specific risks.

trends.name: Tax Refund Volatility & IRS Filing Changes
trends.summary: Average IRS refunds up 10.8% with new data, but some filers report smaller-than-expected returns due to withholding and tax law changes. Creates uncertainty for consumer cash flow and Q2 spending patterns; impacts retail and discretionary sectors.

trends.name: Insurance Regulation & Private Credit Pipeline
trends.summary: State insurance commissioners becoming critical regulators of industry operating as financial pipeline for booming private-credit sector. Regulatory scrutiny increasing on interconnectedness between insurance float and alternative assets amid broader financial stability concerns.
